footer.why: You get this email because of your notification settings.
footer.security: This is a security email about your account. It is always sent.

code.validity: The code works for 10 minutes. If you didn't ask for it, ignore this email: nothing happens without the code.

verify.subject: Confirm your email
verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.intro: Here is the code to confirm this email address for your account:

login.subject: Your login code
login.title: Finish logging in
login.intro: Here is your code to finish logging in:

password.subject: Confirm your new password
password.title: Set a password
password.intro: Here is your code to set a password for logging in with your email:

reset.subject: Reset your password
reset.title: Reset your password
reset.intro: Here is your code to choose a new password:

test.subject: Test email
test.title: Your email works
test.intro: This is a test email. Here is a code that doesn't do anything:

securityNotice.notYou: Wasn't you? Reset your password now and check your sign-in methods.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.title: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.text: The password for logging in with your email was just changed.

passwordReset.subject: Your password was reset
passwordReset.title: Your password was reset
passwordReset.text: Someone used a code sent to this address to set a new password.

passwordRemoved.subject: Email login turned off
passwordRemoved.title: Email login turned off
passwordRemoved.text: The password was removed: logging in with your email is off until you set one again.

twoFactor.subject: Your second step changed
twoFactor.title: Your second step changed
twoFactor.text: The second step for logging in with your email changed: {{change}}.

newBrowser.subject: New login with your email
newBrowser.title: New login
newBrowser.text: Your account was just logged into with your email and password from a new browser ({{browser}}).

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.question: Stop emails about "{{category}}"?
unsubscribe.done: Done. You won't get these emails any more. You can turn them back on in your settings.
unsubscribe.invalid: This link doesn't work (any more). Change your email settings on the site instead.
